study_title: Empirical Engineering Design Trade Space: Concrete Slump Experiments
design: Secondary multi-objective analysis of 103 laboratory mixture experiments

integrity.raw_source_sha256_policy: Computed and printed on every public-source rebuild. A fixed upstream digest is not asserted because the UCI endpoint may be corrected; research-relevant drift is guarded by exact metric and frontier-ID checks.

claim_boundary: This is an empirical trade-space demonstration, not a concrete design recommendation. Frontier membership is conditional on the declared objectives and constraints; durability, cost, safety, uncertainty, curing conditions, and project-specific requirements are not modeled.
